static_review: Public Probe.cpp uses actual Press78Engine API, sets raw carrier TL and plugin MasterGain independently, fresh engine per case, no note-offs/effects/clock jitter/level fitting. All72 parameter tuples match frozen design.

Engine output source applies shared Drive after sum and linear circuit, followed by chorus/DC, then plugin master gain and final softBound limiter. Voice-local feedback enters phase before carrier; AnalogOutput is six linear SOS. This supports separator mechanism without identifying hardware stage location.

MasterGain is not identified as hardware MELODY VOLUME. OutputLimit is safety protection, not target overload. FM feedback is synthesis, not shared postmix distortion. Report explicitly separates all three.
